0.original: You spy a tinge of sadness in Ryne's eyes...

24.original: Speak with Beq Lugg in the Ocular.

26.original: Speak with Livingway near the Drowning Brand.

48.original: Well, I suppose this is it. I don't know if you had any other preparations to attend to or people to visit, but I'll go on ahead to the Ocular.

49.original: It seems Zero is already back in the vessel. I would have liked to talk to her more, but it'll have to wait till next time. And there <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> be a next time. I'm sure of it.

50.original: Before we said our farewells, Zero thanked me, saying that she learned much during her time in Norvrandt. While I don't believe I'm owed such gratitude, I'm nonetheless glad that she found the experience worthwhile.

51.original: The tower stands ready to send Light into the rift, and Zero's soul is secure in her vessel once more.

52.original: Our helpers across the realm have also sent word that the transmitters are in place.

53.original: Once the others have been set on the moon of Zero's world, we should have the foundation for our aetherial current.

54.original: To make matters easier, the transmitters broadcast a powerful signal that can be detected by the tower even across the rift. Upon confirming that the void ones are active, we will send forth the Light!

55.original: The rest will be up to you. We'll all be praying for your success.

56.original: Now go─make haste back to the Source, and save your worlds!

57.original: Worry not, I can manage the tower well enough. Return to the Source, and finish it!

58.original: With so many people willing us on, I have faith that we will succeed.

59.original: The Exarch's spirit abides in this tower. It will surely deliver the Light where it is needed.

60.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I presume the preparations in the First are complete? That is well, for time grows short.

62.original: The Loporrits report that the brands are on the verge of failing. We have no time to spare.

63.original: I shall restore Zero to her body at once.

65.original: I was worried that the soul transference process might affect the Light I absorbed, but it feels as potent as before.

66.original: The radiance of your soul was impossibly blinding. I don't know how you would have managed without Ryne's help.

67.original: While Ryne helped me to contain the Light, it was you─all of you─who gave me the courage to even make the attempt. Your friendship. Your acceptance.

68.original: That includes the people of the First. The Night's Blessed, in particular, showed me great kindness. As did Runar─whose only regret seemed to be that you could not join us.

69.original: A regret we share. Ours is a reunion long overdue.

70.original: If all is in readiness, then I will assume my dragon form and fly to the moon.

71.original: In the meantime, pray make your own way to the Drowning Brand. There we shall reconvene before sallying forth once more into the void.

72.original: The Darkness groweth stronger with every passing moment. Doubt not but that Zeromus shall soon attain full strength.

73.original: The hour is upon us. If everyone is ready, then so am I.

74.original: 'Tis a terrible Darkness indeed that should so test the restraints which once held Zodiark, but with the Light from the First, I am confident we will prevail.

75.original: Golbez will be ready for our return. We must likewise be ready for him.

76.original: Oh, thank goodness you're back! The seal will break at any moment, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! <hex:021A020203>Any moment<hex:021A020103>!

77.original: Time to take the fight to the enemy, is it?

78.original: The Darkness has been utterly relentless, gnawing at the seal like I might an iron carrot.

79.original: Strike fast and hard, because you won't get another chance.

80.original: As a precaution, we've further enhanced the combat supporters. You don't need to worry about us while you're away.

81.original: I shall maintain my vigil over the brands. Pray see that thou art ready to depart as soon as Vrtra and the others have assembled.

82.original: May the Light shine the way to victory, and deliver you all safely home.

83.original: In order to unleash the most concentrated burst of Light possible, we will route the energy to multiple transmitters before directing it to converge at a single point. I will survey the area for suitable locations.

84.original: It's too quiet. Surely they know we're here...

85.original: This time, Sister... This time, I will save you...

87.original: The dark pall over the crater has grown thicker.

88.original: And on the other side lies Golbez's domain. He'll have altered the terrain to hinder us.

89.original: I don't sense his presence, but I wager he is in the crater...

90.original: 'Twould be ideal if he were. I shall hurry and place the transmitters.

91.original: Once they are activated, our cross-rift aetherial current will be established, and Light will flow freely from the First. In theory, at least.
